description: Retrieve the memory entries that answer a question, within a token budget. REQUIRES A KEY (or a sandbox_key from start_sandbox). Send the returned 'context' to your language model INSTEAD of the whole history. This does not call a model itself — it selects what to send. The budget is a ceiling, not a target: selection stops where relevance runs out, often well below it. The response says how many entries were left behind and why. If the response has a 'budget_warning', the best match did not fit: call again with its suggested_token_budget.

auto_spread.description: For questions about a progression ('in what order', 'summarize', 'over time'), cover the whole timeline with short excerpts instead of the best matches.

entry_token_cap.description: Optional. Entries longer than this are returned as an excerpt (opening + best-matching passage, marked [...]), so more entries fit in the budget.

entry_token_cap_speakers.description: Optional, with entry_token_cap: shorten only entries from these speakers, e.g. ["assistant"]; the rest are returned whole.

fill_budget.description: Use the whole budget instead of stopping where relevance drops.

include_standing.description: Always include the user's standing instructions and preferences that fit this query ('Always ...', 'I prefer ...', or tagged instruction/preference), even when worded differently from the question.

order.description: time = oldest first, so the model sees what came before what.

reduce.description: Opt-in (FAS L): shorten the assembled context with a small, local, task-agnostic model before it is returned, to lower your own model's token cost. Requires tenant consent for context_reduction (set via /api/v1/gdpr/consent) — otherwise the call is rejected with SAMTYCKE_KRAVS instead of silently ignoring the request. NOT query-aware: selection is driven by what is least informative in general, not by this query.

sandbox_key.description: Optional. A temporary key from start_sandbox, for trying without an account.

speaker_weights.description: Optional. Score multiplier per speaker label, e.g. {"assistant": 0.5} to favour what the user said over your own earlier replies.

spread_over_time.description: After the strongest matches, cover the whole timeline: for questions about an order of events, a progression or a summary.

standing_budget.description: With include_standing: extra tokens for the instructions on top of token_budget, so they do not displace memories. 0 = inside token_budget.

target_tokens.description: Only relevant together with reduce=true. How many tokens the assembled context should be shortened to. Omit for a default halving of what was actually retrieved.

whole_top.description: Optional, with entry_token_cap: the N best matches are always returned whole.

name: assemble_context
title: Retrieve relevant memory
